args.title: Make BOM Usage in CSV Export Configurable
args.body:
File: src/export/csv.ts

Introduce configuration to control the use of a byte order mark (BOM) when exporting files in the CSV format. This change allows users to specify if the BOM should be included or not, leveraging the CsvOptions interface for flexibility.

label: feature
file: src/export/csv.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The writeCsv function in src/export/csv.ts prefixes a byte order mark (BOM) by default when exporting CSV files, as controlled by the CsvOptions interface.
